bacon until crisp.Add 1 diced onion and 2 celery sticks and cook 5 minutes.Stir in 2 tbsp plain flour, then 300ml fish stock, 400ml milk, 400g diced potato and thyme.Simmer 15 minutes.Add 1kg vongole
